title: Maximize Number of Subsequences in a String
goal: Insert one character to maximize occurrences of a two-character subsequence.
strategy: Count existing pattern subsequences in one pass. Inserting the first pattern character at the front adds every second-character occurrence; inserting the second at the end adds every first-character occurrence.
